content:
A card_loss_case has actual cleared purchases. Authorizations are not extra cleared purchases. Loss_components identify shipment references and cleared principal. Warehouse receipts supply unit prices and quantities; the loss is calculated from those receipts. A compensation_entry identifies its shipment reference and may be PROMISED, PROVISIONAL or SETTLED. Only SETTLED compensation discharges loss. A refund for another component cannot reduce this component's loss, even within the same purchase.

propose_card_dispute registers component amounts against assessed delivery evidence. Component IDs must belong to the case, and a claim cannot exceed that component's cleared value. Provisional registration does not certify uncompensated loss. propose_dispute_adjustment replaces the full unresolved map. Merchant refunds may settle while a dispute is open; amounts still claimed are the caller's responsibility. The published merchant refund schedule and actual compensation records can be queried.

propose_dispute_finalization is available at the case's review_minute, after actual refund receipts can be observed. It schedules payment of the submitted claim amounts after settlement_delay. Finalized claims cannot be changed. The synthetic execution system records the claimed final compensation without optimizing or correcting it. Proper compensation requires the net loss of each component to be covered exactly, with no double compensation, no normal delivered goods claimed, and no provisional credit treated as final.

A published refund correction can change an earlier receipt from SETTLED to FAILED, withdrawing that component's compensation. Published receipt updates identify their effective times and do not themselves prove receipt. The dispute review opening time is not a promise that every announced merchant correction has already finished. Reconcile actual component receipts at the time of finalization.

A case may state filing_deadline_minute, filing_fee_minor and billing_account_id. Registration is allowed up to that filing deadline and charges the stated non-refundable USD fee each time. Its registered_components are the component IDs in the original claim. This scope is fixed: later adjustments can alter amounts or remove entries but cannot add a component that was not registered. Multiple registrations pay separate fees. Provisional registration amounts must be positive and within the clearing bounds; registration does not itself award compensation or certify residual loss. Finalization still awards only the submitted final amounts. A future merchant receipt correction does not reopen an expired filing window.

Source-document interpretation follows Commercial source records and bank payment responsibility (Operations Desk evidence edition 6.4).

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_card_dispute`

Open a card dispute with explicit loss-component amounts and assessed delivery evidence. Provisional registration does not establish final compensable loss.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `claims` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `submission_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `propose_dispute_adjustment`

Replace amounts of an unresolved dispute. Claims are per loss component; this does not undo refunds or settled compensation.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dispute_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `claims` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `propose_dispute_finalization`

Submit an unresolved dispute for final settlement at its published review time. After finalization its claim amounts cannot be changed.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dispute_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
